# Independent Portable PDB fixture

`Documents.pdb` is the unchanged Microsoft .NET runtime test resource:
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/src/libraries/System.Reflection.Metadata/tests/Resources/PortablePdbs/Documents.pdb

Git blob SHA: `ee0a1421085feeebf829e4f3b0ad972cc2e9c22c`.
Retrieved October 2, 2026. MIT license is retained beside the fixture.
It covers thirteen case-sensitive Windows/document paths, document switches,
signed line deltas, a hidden sequence point, and import scopes. It was NOT
produced by SharpForge. This is symbol-format interoperability, not evidence
of successful external CLR execution.
